platformNote.INSTAGRAM: Instagram professional accounts linked to a Facebook Page. Photos, carousels and Reels.
platformNote.FACEBOOK: Facebook Pages you manage. Text, photos, multi-photo posts and videos.
platformNote.TIKTOK: TikTok creator accounts. Videos and photo posts.
platformNote.LINKEDIN: LinkedIn profiles and Company Pages (Pages need LinkedIn approval). Text, images, videos.

restrictions.INSTAGRAM: Needs a professional Instagram account linked to a Facebook Page, and a Meta app with Advanced Access (app review and business verification) for other people’s accounts. No text-only posts: they go to manual publishing. Media must be a public https address; images must be JPEG.
restrictions.FACEBOOK: Needs a Meta app with Advanced Access (app review) to publish to Pages of other people. The person must have the CREATE_CONTENT task on the Page. Reels on Facebook are not published through the API (manual).
restrictions.TIKTOK: Until TikTok audits the app, every post is private to the creator. Videos are fetched from a verified domain. No text-only posts (manual).
restrictions.YOUTUBE: Uploads cost API quota (1,600 units each, 10,000 per day by default). Videos uploaded by a Google project that has not passed Google’s audit are locked to private. Videos only.
restrictions.LINKEDIN: Posting as a person needs the “Share on LinkedIn” product; posting as a Company Page needs the Community Management API, approved by LinkedIn. Tokens last 60 days and can be renewed automatically only for approved partners.

not.NOT_PUBLISHED: Metrics exist only for published posts.

reconcile.UNAVAILABLE: The platform could not be checked.

personal.title: Personal profile
personal.note: Publish as yourself. Available with LinkedIn's "Share on LinkedIn" product.
personal.disabled: Personal LinkedIn publishing is switched off on this server.

organization.note: Publish as a Company Page you administer.

sales.title: AI sales agent
sales.handoffBanner: This customer needs a person ({reason}). The AI is paused until you take over or resume it.

conversations.title: AI conversations
conversations.subtitle: What customers ask, what the agent answered, and where a person is needed.
conversations.emptyHint: Turn the agent on in the Agent tab and share its chat link. You can try it first in the test chat.
conversations.selectHint: Pick a conversation to read it, review the AI's replies, or take over.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: People who talked to your agent, with what they shared and where they are in your sales process.
customers.search: Search by name, email or phone
customers.emptyHint: Customers appear here when someone starts a conversation with your agent.
customers.erased: This customer's personal data was erased.
customers.eraseText: Contact details, notes and the texts of their messages are removed permanently. Anonymous statistics are kept. This cannot be undone.

leads.title: Leads
leads.subtitle: Customers by stage. Stages advance by themselves from what customers say and share; you decide Won and Lost.
leads.emptyHint: A visitor becomes a lead once they show interest in a product or service.

opportunities.title: Sales opportunities
opportunities.subtitle: Who is ready to buy, what they want, and what to do next.
opportunities.hint: Customers with high purchase intent. Product names and prices are read from your catalog now.
opportunities.emptyHint: Customers who clearly want to buy appear here.

followUps.title: Follow-up recommendations
followUps.hint: Rule-based suggestions: what needs a person, and why. Nothing is sent automatically.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Verified answers the agent can use, and the questions it could not answer.
faq.unansweredTitle: Questions the agent could not answer
faq.unansweredHint: Customers asked these and the agent had no verified answer, so it handed over to a person. Add the answers so it can help next time.
faq.question: Question
faq.answerPlaceholder: The correct answer, exactly as you want customers to read it
faq.unverifiedNote: Saved as an unverified entry. The agent uses it only after someone with permission verifies it in the knowledge base.
faq.saved: Answer saved. Verify it in the knowledge base so the agent can use it.
faq.verifiedHint: Verified FAQ entries from the knowledge base appear here.

analytics.title: Conversation analytics
analytics.subtitle: Counted from real conversations. Nothing here is estimated.
analytics.note: Counted from stored conversations. Conversion to a sale is not measured: TOUMA has no order data.

agent.title: Agent settings
agent.subtitle: Turn the agent on, choose its languages and how it answers, and test it.
agent.enabledHint: Off by default. While off, the public chat does not exist.
agent.name: Agent name
agent.languagesHint: The agent detects the customer's language. If it is not enabled here, it answers in the default language.
agent.greetingPlaceholder: Leave empty for the standard greeting

REVIEW.title: Review every reply (recommended to start)
REVIEW.text: The AI writes a draft; the customer sees nothing until a person approves it.

AUTO.title: Answer customers automatically
AUTO.text: The AI answers customer-initiated chats by itself from your verified data. Anything uncertain or sensitive still goes to a person.

agent.maxRepliesHint: After this many, the conversation goes to a person.
agent.safetyNote: The agent only uses your verified information, never invents prices, stock or policies, cannot see orders or take payments, and hands over refunds, complaints and anything it cannot verify.
agent.readOnly: You can view these settings; an administrator can change them.
agent.publicLinkHint: Share this link or put it on your website or social profiles.
agent.autoText: You are authorizing TOUMA's agent to answer customers on your behalf.
agent.autoDetails: It will answer customer-initiated chats using only your verified products, services and policies. It cannot place orders, take payments or promise anything. You can switch back to review mode at any time. This authorization is recorded.
agent.minConfidence: Answer automatically only when confidence is
agent.minConfidenceHint: Below this level the reply becomes a draft for a person. Low confidence always goes to a person.
agent.privacyUrlHint: Shown in the customer chat next to TOUMA's short notice. Must start with https://.
agent.retentionHint: Conversations and personal data are erased after this many days without activity (30 to 1825). Anonymous statistics are kept.

playground.title: Test chat
playground.hint: Try the agent as a customer would. Test conversations are not counted and nothing is sent anywhere.
playground.placeholder: Ask something, for example the price of a product

reply.label: Reply to the customer
reply.placeholderTakeover: Writing a reply takes the conversation over from the AI
reply.takesOver: Sending a reply pauses the AI for this conversation.

msg.injection: Possible attempt to give the AI instructions was detected and ignored.

report.title: Report an inaccurate reply
report.text: Tell us what was wrong and what is correct. The correction is recorded for your team.
report.addKnowledge: Add the correction to the knowledge base
report.addKnowledgeHint: Saved as unverified: the agent uses it only after it is verified.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.hint: Only your team sees these. They are never shown to the customer or the AI.

chat.name: Your name
chat.consent: I agree to be contacted at these details about my request.
chat.waiting: A member of the team will reply here.
chat.error: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.
chat.tooMany: Too many messages. Please contact the business directly.
chat.unavailableText: This chat is not available right now.

monitoring.title: AI monitoring
monitoring.subtitle: Is the AI answering? How many calls, failures, tokens and handoffs. No message content is ever shown here.
monitoring.notConfigured: No AI model is configured on this server, so every customer question is handed to your team. Ask your administrator to add the AI provider credentials.
monitoring.bannerDown: The AI agent is failing to answer: customers are being handed to your team.
monitoring.bannerDegraded: The AI agent is having trouble: many recent answers failed.
monitoring.costHint: Cost is unknown because no price is configured for this model (AI_MODEL_PRICING). It is never shown as zero.
monitoring.note: Counted from recorded AI calls and conversations. Draft approval rate is only meaningful once enough drafts were reviewed.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: Automated sequences with a person approving every sensitive step.
workflows.simulated: Simulation: no AI model is called, nothing is published and no calendar entry is created.
workflows.disabled: Workflows are not enabled for this platform yet.
workflows.outcomeUnknown: The result of this action is unknown. Check outside TOUMA, then tell us what happened.
workflows.needsApproval: Waiting for a person to approve

market.title: Market intelligence
market.subtitle: Research a product, see its margin and an opportunity score you can verify.
market.notice: Figures come from the records you enter, with the source you name. Nothing is looked up, scraped or estimated: what you leave empty stays unknown.
market.disabled: Market intelligence is not enabled for this platform yet.
market.importHint: Enter what you found and where you found it.

a.title: Assumptions
a.hint: Replace the example values with your own. Empty fields stay unknown.
a.fxRate: Exchange rate (selling currency per 1 unit of cost currency)

market.duplicate: This product is already in your research.
